why: A full local render, 157 s — "Glass and Neon". Also the track the karaoke screenshot is driving.
LTX 2.5 — the better engine on the numbers, and the one Studio cannot fetch for you: 5 s at 1280x704 in about two minutes.
Denoise 0.60 — still a copy. r = 0.94 against the near-copy end of the dial.
Denoise 0.85 — the shipped default. Waveform correlation has collapsed to 0.004: a new performance.
Denoise 0.95 — past the useful range; the reference stops steering it.

YuE2 3B — “Hold the Morning Back”, big-room festival house, 2:45. Rendered from the score the model planned, on the 16 GB card; ended by itself, not at the cap. Every YuE2 song is original — lyrics written for it; tune, chords and arrangement the model's — and CC BY-NC 4.0 reaches it: not for sale.
